aiSummary.oneLiner: Adobe Acrobat automation via scripting for PDF workflows.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides scripts and tools for automating tasks within Adobe Acrobat, such as PDF creation, editing, and manipulation. It leverages Acrobat's JavaScript API to enable programmatic interaction with PDF files. The distinctive aspect is its focus on streamlining repetitive PDF workflows through custom scripts tailored to Acrobat's capabilities.
keyFeatures: PDF Creation: Automates the generation of PDFs from templates or raw data.
Batch Processing: Executes operations like merging or splitting PDFs across multiple files.
Annotation Automation: Adds comments, highlights, or stamps programmatically.
Form Handling: Automates filling, validation, and extraction of PDF form data.
Metadata Editing: Updates document properties such as title, author, and keywords.
Custom Acrobat Actions: Enables creation of reusable workflows within Acrobat.

useCases.title: Batch PDF Merging
useCases.description: A publishing team combines hundreds of PDFs into a single document using automated scripts to save time.

useCases.title: Automated Form Filling
useCases.description: HR departments populate employee forms programmatically from a database, reducing manual entry errors.

useCases.title: Metadata Standardization
useCases.description: Legal teams update document metadata across thousands of case files for compliance purposes.

useCases.title: Custom Review Annotations
useCases.description: Design reviewers add consistent comments and stamps to PDFs using pre-defined scripts.

useCases.title: PDF Splitting for Archiving
useCases.description: Archivists split large documents into smaller sections based on predefined rules for storage.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This is for developers or technical users familiar with Adobe Acrobat and JavaScript, looking to automate PDF workflows.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Clone the repository and follow the README instructions to set up the scripts. Example: `git clone https://github.com/BehemothSpongeSquare/adobe-acrobat.git`.
